verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop has public documentation sites (help.ubuntu.com, documentation.ubuntu.com), so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis for it. Probes found no such resources: llms.txt and the markdown docs path both returned HTTP 404, and nothing in the docs mentions agent-oriented documentation. Confidence is medium because only help.ubuntu.com was probed, not documentation.ubuntu.com.
